description: This file manages skills within a workspace, including loading, filtering, path resolution, and synchronization of skills, with functions for building skill prompts and snapshots for AI interactions.

methods.name: compactSkillPaths
methods.description: Replaces user's home directory prefix with '~' in skill file paths to reduce token usage.

methods.name: filterSkillEntries
methods.description: Filters skill entries based on inclusion criteria, optional skill filter, and eligibility.

methods.name: resolveSkillsLimits
methods.description: Determines skill limits from configuration or defaults.

methods.name: listChildDirectories
methods.description: Lists subdirectories within a directory, ignoring certain entries.

methods.name: tryRealpath
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the real path of a file, returns null if fails.

methods.name: warnEscapedSkillPath
methods.description: Logs a warning when a skill path resolves outside its root.

methods.name: resolveContainedSkillPath
methods.description: Resolves a skill path ensuring it is inside the root directory.

methods.name: filterLoadedSkillsInsideRoot
methods.description: Filters skills to ensure they are inside the specified root directory.

methods.name: resolveNestedSkillsRoot
methods.description: Detects nested skills root directory heuristically.

methods.name: unwrapLoadedSkills
methods.description: Extracts skills array from loaded data.

methods.name: loadSkillEntries
methods.description: Loads skill entries from workspace directory, considering various skill sources and size limits.

methods.name: escapeXml
methods.description: Escapes special XML characters in a string.

methods.name: formatSkillsCompact
methods.description: Formats a compact list of skills with name and location for prompt use.

methods.name: applySkillsPromptLimits
methods.description: Limits skills included in prompt based on character and count budgets, with fallback to compact format.

methods.name: buildWorkspaceSkillSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of workspace skills including prompt and metadata.

methods.name: buildWorkspaceSkillsPrompt
methods.description: Builds a prompt string listing workspace skills.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveWorkspaceSkillFilter
methods.description: Resolves the effective skill filter based on options and configuration.

methods.name: resolveWorkspaceSkillPromptState
methods.description: Resolves the current state of skills and prompt for a workspace.

methods.name: resolveSkillsPromptForRun
methods.description: Resolves the prompt string for a skill run, using snapshot or generated prompt.

methods.name: loadWorkspaceSkillEntries
methods.description: Loads skill entries with optional filtering.

methods.name: loadVisibleWorkspaceSkillEntries
methods.description: Loads skill entries that are visible, with filtering.

methods.name: resolveUniqueSyncedSkillDirName
methods.description: Generates a unique directory name for synced skills.

methods.name: resolveSyncedSkillDestinationPath
methods.description: Resolves destination path for syncing a skill, ensuring safety.

methods.name: syncSkillsToWorkspace
methods.description: Synchronizes skills from source to target workspace, copying directories safely.

methods.name: filterWorkspaceSkillEntries
methods.description: Filters workspace skill entries based on configuration.

methods.name: filterWorkspaceSkillEntriesWithOptions
methods.description: Filters workspace skill entries with additional options.
